text.body:
[extra\recto]-nakulasaṃpradājavardhaṇī śastā ||
snātvāmbupañcagavyai[r] liptvā gandhādinā ca tā samābhyarcyaḥ |
nipuṇasudhīrācāryo vṛkṣe 'tra yathā tathā sarvam || [curl] ||
nagarapraveśasamaye vanato drumarājaśailakhaṇḍānām [|]
narapatipaurajaneṣu ca śubhavāratā[=°vārtāṃ] gocarīkuryāt ||
madanavalitalokair vāhayet puṣṭacittai[r]
gurur api jinamantrī tūryasaṃgītighoṣaiḥ |
dadhijalaparipūrṇaṃ dvāri kumbhaṃ nidhāya
pramudamadakaṭākṣāsundarībhiḥ prapūjyaḥ ||
vasanakusumadāmauhāradīpyambuvarṣaiḥ {|}
paramamuditacittaiḥ svāmivargaiḥ praveśya |
vipulasamasubhūmau piṣṭakāmbhojamadhye
gurukarajalasiktaṃ sthāpayet karmasiddhyai{ḥ} || [curl] ||
vanayātrādhikāraḥ saptamaḥ || 70 || [!]
% so it was copied over from a full version of the Karmādhikāravidhāna??
sthānādimānayuktaṃ lakṣaṇam atulaṃ śubhaṃ samādiṣṭam |
nānāsvāgamakāṇḍe buddhaiḥ kāruṇyamānasair etat ||
saptaparamāṇuyogād aṇur ity a[ṇu]saptabhiś ca sūkṣmarajaḥ |
saptarajobhiḥ atheṭakaraja ity abhidhīyate sadbhiḥ ||
saptaitaka(!)rajobhi[r] gauraja [extra\verso] iti saptabhiś ca yūkā syāt |
yūkāsaptame yava iti saṃkhyānam āyāti ||
saptayavair aṅgulikā madhyāṣṭayavais tu sāṅgulī jyeṣṭhā |
% papta° \ms
ṣaḍyavaguṇitāṅgulikā vikhyātā kanyasī bhadrāḥ ||
tābhir dvādaśabhir vārvistariti (!?) dviguṇitena hastaḥ syāt |
kanyasamadhyamajyeṣṭhā trividhā hastās tu varṇabhedena ||
visamayavāṅgulihastāḥ kalyāṇāḥ sarvakāryakaradhoṇeṣu (?) |
va[r]jyās te samāḥ śreyo'rthibhir atra kā[r]yeṣu ||
dhvajadhumasiṃhasvānaṃ vṛṣakharagajadhvāṅkalāmakācāṣṭau |
ity ākrāntā nipuṇaiḥ saṃyojyāḥ sarvakāryeṣu ||
dhvajam iti yativiprāṇāṃ śātikathākṣā[r]thināṃ mahāśastaṃ
siṃhakṣatriyanṛpater bhūmījayavīryakāmānām ||
vṛṣabhaṃ śūdrajanānāṃ dhanadhānyasamṛddhipuṣṭikāmānā[m] |
gajam iti va[=ca] vaiśyavaṇijāṃ paśuparijabhūtivaśyakānām || [curl] ||
hastamānasthāpanavidhiḥ || [curl] || [fleuron] ||
